prompt: 我们的 FastAPI 服务抓取微信公众号 HTML 后只拿到纯文本，文章里经常有表格截图。请接入 PaddleOCR：图片并发但按正文顺序回填，识别文本必须进入 DeepSeek 总结和后续日报。token 只能本机保存。
assertions: OCR is placed before canonical source-text persistence, not only in a UI preview.
The solution uses bounded concurrency and preserves original DOM order.
The token is not returned by GET endpoints or exposed in source/logs.
Daily and weekly reports use the complete enriched article body rather than a short summary excerpt.
